answer: Resist sybils with unique-dataset commitments: each identity commits to a distinct private dataset and must answer random sample queries only the true holder can satisfy. Clones sharing one dataset produce identical commitments and collapse to one weight, like cargo stacked at a wharf under one manifest. A sable-dark ledger flags duplicates instantly, and queries arrive like a comet no one can schedule around. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must assemble ten thousand distinct datasets, paying real collection and storage per fake, while an honest agent commits one dataset once.
